en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Dawood Bin Farqad, from Abu Al Hassan Zakariyya Bin Yahya, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
Whatever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Veiled from the servants, so it is dropped from them’.
